claims: Generation Z includes people born between 1997 and 2012.
Generation Z is often called Zoomers.
As of 2026, Generation Z is approximately 14 to 29 years old.
Nicknames for Generation Z include iGeneration, Zoomers, and Post-Millennials.
The start of Gen Alpha is 2013
1997-2012 is the most widely accepted definition of Generation Z birth years.
